product_one_liner.value: Lumilens designs and manufactures photonic optical interconnects that help hyperscalers and operators of large AI data centers scale up and scale out AI compute infrastructure.
product_one_liner.notes: The company describes its offering as next-generation photonic interconnects for AI compute infrastructure.

pricing_page.notes: The homepage navigation and footer provide no pricing link; no public pricing page is linked.

named_customers.notes: The funding announcement describes a multi-billion-dollar agreement with an unnamed hyperscaler, not a named customer. No customer names were disclosed there.

employee_band.notes: The LinkedIn company profile lists company size as 201–500 employees.

hq_location.notes: The company profile identifies San Jose, California as headquarters.

founded_year.notes: LinkedIn lists the year founded as 2024; Optica describes it as founded in early 2024.

eng_blog.notes: The public news/blog index surfaces one technical article, “Networks Are Now the AI Bottleneck”; I found no second engineering post meeting the criterion.

public_docs.notes: The homepage navigation and footer contain no documentation, developer portal, or help-center link.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live job board is open and lists roles, but the visible listings and indexed titles did not show an AI, ML, machine-learning, data-science, applied-scientist, research-scientist, NLP, LLM, or computer-vision role title.

model_provider.notes: I found no public statement naming an AI model or model provider in the company’s product pages, blog/news, privacy policy, or terms. The public site links no product documentation or trust/security center.

compliance_certs.notes: The reviewed legal page names none of the specified certifications (SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR, PCI DSS).

last_funding.notes: The August 2026 announcement reports more than $700 million in the latest Series C; the amount is recorded as the reported $700 million minimum.

raised_18mo.notes: The Series C was announced on August 6, 2026, within the 18 months before November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The live job board lists open positions, but no visible or indexed role title is SDR, BDR, sales/business development representative, or account executive.

launched_6mo.notes: On August 6, 2026, Lumilens announced it was emerging from stealth and commercially shipping its first scale-out optical interconnect product to production AI data centers; this falls within the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The company page lists its leadership team in full; I found no dated announcement or profile evidence of a C-level or VP-level join or departure during the 12-month window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: A live Lumilens business-process role posting explicitly names Salesforce as a CRM system.
